title: QUIZ - 16
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.learningObjective: Determine the percentage increase or decrease between two values
questions.question: A quantity changed from 114 to 178. What is the percentage increase (rounded to one decimal place)?
questions.explanation: Percentage change is calculated as (new - old) / old \(\times 100 = (178 - 114) / 114 \times 100 \approx 56.1\)%, a increase of 56.1%.
questions.hint: Percentage change = (new value - old value) / old value, expressed as a percent.

questions.learningObjective: Calculate the new value after a percentage increase or decrease
questions.question: A value of 264 is decreased by 20%. What is the new value?
questions.hint: Multiply the original value by (1 + rate) for an increase, or (1 - rate) for a decrease.

questions.learningObjective: Determine the percentage increase or decrease between two values
questions.question: A quantity changed from 202 to 261. What is the percentage increase (rounded to one decimal place)?
questions.explanation: Percentage change is calculated as (new - old) / old \(\times 100 = (261 - 202) / 202 \times 100 \approx 29.2\)%, a increase of 29.2%.
questions.hint: Percentage change = (new value - old value) / old value, expressed as a percent.

questions.learningObjective: Apply two successive percentage changes and compute the final value
questions.question: A value starts at 190. It is first increased by 20%, then the result is increased by 25%. What is the final value (rounded to two decimal places)?
questions.explanation: Apply the changes one at a time. After the first change: \(190 \to 228.0\). After the second change: \(228.0 \to 285.0\). Successive percentage changes cannot simply be added together.
questions.hint: Apply each percentage change to the result of the previous step, not to the original value.
